description: Routing eval for multi-agent-architect's closest seams: multi-agent system design and wrapper-stack diagnosis versus a single prompt artifact (prompt-engineer/prompt-craft) and ordinary cross-service architecture (principal-engineer). The hard signals are the negatives, because all three named agents under-fire in one-shot headless mode.
notes: Seeded 2026-07-30 after the fleet review found no routing coverage for multi-agent-architect. Agent positives are weak absolute signals under the caveat in ../README.md; negatives are intentional sibling disambiguators and forbid only the wrong members so the correct sibling may fire.

cases.prompt: Design a five-agent research and verification system with an orchestrator, explicit handoff schemas, context budgets, and failure handling.
cases.expected_output: A system of agents with orchestration and handoff contracts is multi-agent-architect's core design remit.

cases.prompt: My direct LLM call is correct, but the answer becomes wrong after prompt assembly, memory retrieval, summarization, and delivery. Diagnose the agent application stack.
cases.expected_output: A wrapper-layer regression and delivery mutation is multi-agent-architect diagnostic work, even when the system has one model.

cases.prompt: My one classifier system prompt ignores the instruction to return JSON. Baseline it across repeated runs and tune the prompt.
cases.expected_output: One prompt with measured iterative tuning belongs to prompt-engineer. multi-agent-architect is forbidden; prompt-engineer firing is intentionally allowed.

cases.prompt: Design a backward-compatible migration from synchronous order calls to events across payments and fulfillment, with rollout and rollback.
cases.expected_output: Ordinary multi-service software architecture belongs to principal-engineer. AI-agent vocabulary is absent, so both agent/prompt specialists are forbidden.

cases.prompt: Draft one Claude Code agent prompt that summarizes support tickets. Keep it one-shot; no eval suite and no agent roster.
cases.expected_output: A single quick agent prompt belongs to prompt-craft. The word agent alone must not promote the task to multi-agent system design.
